text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft's 『Fillies' Review』 was
approaching. In preparation 
for the race, I was analyzing her opponents,
however――

(Particularly 『Daring Heart』 and 『Air
Messiah』……these two. 
She would have to keep both in mind for the
Fillies' Review)

(Daring Heart had finished 5th in the Hanshin
JF, however, 
lately she'd been growing stronger
consistently. There was a 
high possibility she'd show her true potential
this time.)

(Air Messiah was currently at two wins and
one 
second place finish out of three races……It
was 
almost certain she'd have a solid run as
well)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's see,
『Kanchiku Sho』 from a different angle……Found
it! 
Cesario's run……I need to observe it more
closely……!

(As I thought……Kraft is focusing only on
Cesario. She wasn't 
concentrating on the upcoming 『Fillies'
Review』 at all……)

You've been researching Cesario pretty heavily,
but she's not going 
to be running in the 『Fillies' Review』 ……You
know that, right?

You've been researching Cesario pretty heavily,
but she's not going 
to be running in the 『Fillies' Review』 ……You
know that, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Eh, um……Yeah! 
I know……that already……

……Then, can you tell me who you 
should be marking in the next race?

……Then, can you tell me who you 
should be marking in the next race?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Uh……well, that's…… 
…………

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh!? A-a break!? At this time……!?

Yeah. For the current you,
there's something you need to do first.
――You need to see with your own 
eyes what your next opponents are capable
of.

Yeah. For the current you,
there's something you need to do first.
――You need to see with your own 
eyes what your next opponents are capable
of.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Y-……Yes. I understand……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(So, I'm the only one taking a break…… 
And, while I'm doing this, Cesario is――)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(……wait,
no no no! I'm thinking about her again! 
I need to put Cesario aside for now~……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Let's see,
according to the documents that
Trainer-san 
gave me……the first one I should focus on
is――

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart-san…… 
――!?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
No waaaa~y! Heart,
your race uniform looks 
reeeeeeally~~ good on you! It's the best!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Thanks♪ It makes me really happy that so
many people came to 
see me!
It's almost like this is an unveiling party,
fufufuu!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Of course they'd come~,
they've been waiting for this! 
Your sense and style are out of this world~
……I can't 
wait to see you win while wearing that!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! Look forward to it♪ Then,
maybe I should go for 
a little run to get used to it. Everyone,
will you tag along?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Okay~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa―― 
3, 2, 1……――fire!! Haaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Wah, it's Heart!
Amazing……that girl's always surrounded by 
her friends but, when she can run like that,
it makes sense……!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend D
text_block_list.text:
I know~.
An exchange student from an Elite
family……normally 
just that would make her stand out,
but she has the talent too!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Has it?
Isn't it more like she's getting better? 
Compared to before,
isn't her body way more toned now!?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Definitely~! In the next race, seems like 
she'll show us an even more amazing
run……! 
She's like our Queen! Heart,
you're so cool~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Daring Heart-san……if I recall,
in the 『Hanshin JF』 
she ran together as one of my opponents,
but――)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Like those girls around her said,
without a doubt, 
she's much stronger than back then!
A powerful leader 
style runner……that's my next opponent――)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Rhein Kraft!
Did you come here to see me?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
H-Heart-san! Um, no, well~…… 
this is definitely not reconnaissance……!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I welcome reconnaissance though!
If you'd like, 
how about a closer look? And,
if there's anything you want to ask,
just tell me. I'll answer it all♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even then, I don't intend to lose against 
you in the 『Fillies' Review』 though.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll dominate that race.
I won't let you take my position. 
Compared to the 『Hanshin JF』,
you should think of me as 
a different person. I've become stronger,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
As the same Leader-type,
let's battle it out head-to-head. 
And then, I'll be the one to win,
Rhein Kraft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Now, shake my hand, OK? 
Looking forward to the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(This girl. ……She has the ability, 
her aura……and her heart are strong……!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Then,
Air Messiah-san! In your previous run in 
the 『Elfin Stakes』,
you were able to take a good 
position and magnificently pull ahead,
so――

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It seems that your morale and ability are 
both high!
In regards to the 『Triple Tiara』, 
would you say that you are fully prepared
now!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I believe that preparation includes
following a 
procedure and performing it flawlessly.
But also, 
unexpected situations will still occur during
races.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
First,
in regards to the upcoming 『Oka Sho』, 
on the same Hanshin racecourse during the 
『Fillies' Review』,
I plan on obtaining a solid result――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I hope to improve myself,
and develop an unshakable foundation.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That's……Air Messiah-san……! 
That's right, if I recall,
her mother is――)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see, thank you very much!
It has been said that 
your sincere and steady disposition
ressembles 
that of your mother during her career,
however――

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
During the Triple Tiara rotation,
your mother reached 
top three in each race,
though with the unfortunate 
result of never placing first.
In regards to that――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, but that's precisely why.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
As her daughter,
I will win. Without fail. ……to everyone 
gathered here today, at that time,
please speak about this――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Not my mother's regret――but about the 
splendor and glory she left behind.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Air Messiah-san……she's so calm and feels
like an 
intellectual……but, definitely,
that girl is also――)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft-san.
……I apologize for the late introduction. 
Thank you for attending my press
conference.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah……no! Rather than attending, 
it's more like I just snuck in,
but well……!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, do not mind it.
I have no intention of hiding anything. 
……the 『Fillies' Review』 is quickly
approaching.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I've heard of your success. However,
I have no intention 
of falling behind.
……I look forward to our match.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(This girl……she's composed,
but passionate……! 
I can almost see the fire burning in her
eyes……!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Messiah-san,
and Heart-san……I didn't know anything 
about them. I didn't realize! Their strength,
or how 
intimidating they were at all……!)

The next day――Rhein Kraft showed up for
training 
with a completely different look on her
face!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
――Thank you for giving me the opportunity,
Trainer-san! 
I got a proper look at both of them.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san's running is somewhat similar to
mine. 
And she……has self-confidence backed by a
strong heart.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
In a battle for position,
I don't think she'll ever back down.
If I had run without being aware of it, 
I would have been caught up in my opponent's
pace.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And then Messiah-san……I had watched some of
her old race footage, however,
when it comes to the last stretch, she's 
stronger.
I can't win against her in that regard.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I had run without being conscious of
that…… 
then definitely at the end she would out
pace me.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……This was no time for me to be focusing on
other things. 
There are so many things that I need to
do……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san!!
So that I can win against those two―― 
please train me so that I can win the
『Fillies' Review』!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Yaaaaaa!!

And so,
Rhein Kraft began spending the days 
training for the 『Fillies' Review』.
Then――!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
…………Alright. 
Heart-san! Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Looking forward to the 『Fillies' Review』. 
I won't lose.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I will win against you. 
Today, that's why I'm running……!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
……she's leveled quite a bit.
It felt like her eyes were 
piercing right through me……I could feel the
pressure.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So nice! Isn't that fine? 
――That's how it should be, Rhein Kraft!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
――And now we're entering the straight!
Daring Heart suddenly 
pulls ahead from 5th!
Air Messiah chases after her!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
But――It's Rhein Kraft, it's Rhein Kraft! 
The favorite, Rhein Kraft,
also pushes forward!!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart and Air Messiah chase! 
It's a showdown!
It's a truly close battle!!

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Live Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Goal!! It was close,
it was an incredibly close 1st place 
for Rhein Kraft!
Rhein Kraft wins the 『Fillies' Review』!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(They were strong! Heart-san,
and Messiah-san too, 
really……! But,
I managed to win! I did it!!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
……~~~~!! I did it……!!! 
I did it, I did it, I did it……!!

And so,
Rhein Kraft obtained a splendid victory 
at the 『Fillies' Review』,
building a great deal 
of momentum towards her next goal,
the 『Oka Sho』……
